mapper.select: SELECT id, school_id, name, create_time, update_time FROM classes WHERE school_id = #{schoolId} ORDER BY id ASC
SELECT id, school_id, name, create_time, update_time FROM classes WHERE id = #{id}
SELECT id, school_id, name, create_time, update_time FROM classes WHERE `name` = #{name} AND school_id = #{schoolId}
SELECT id, school_id, name, create_time, update_time FROM classes WHERE school_id = #{schoolId} AND `name` LIKE CONCAT('%', #{key}, '%')

SELECT c.id, c.school_id, c.name, c.create_time, c.update_time, COUNT(cm.id) AS memberCount FROM classes c LEFT JOIN class_members cm ON c.id = cm.class_id WHERE c.school_id = #{schoolId} GROUP BY c.id, c.school_id, c.name, c.create_time, c.update_time ORDER BY c.id ASC
